description: This file contains CMake scripts for processing linker scatter files, including functions for symbol translation, section and region string generation, and external symbol handling. It is used for configuring linker behavior in embedded or system-level projects.

methods.name: process_region
methods.description: Post-processes a memory region for symbol translation and section management in linker scripts.

methods.name: system_to_string
methods.description: Converts system regions into string representations for linker scripts.

methods.name: group_to_string
methods.description: Generates string representations for grouped sections or regions.

methods.name: section_to_string
methods.description: Converts section properties into string format for linker scripts.

methods.name: symbol_to_string
methods.description: Converts symbol properties into string format for linker scripts.
